t: A low-power AI chip for spotting people, objects, and gestures with a camera.
steps: Buy a Grove Vision AI Module V2 from Seeed Studio or RobotShop for about 16 to 20 US dollars.
Buy a compatible camera module, as the board ships without one.
Plug the camera into the board and connect a USB-C cable to your computer.
Open SenseCraft AI in a Chrome or Edge browser.
Flash the pretrained person detection model from the model list.
Watch the live preview draw boxes around people.
Install the Arduino IDE and the Seeed_Arduino_SSCMA library to read results on a XIAO board.
Try Edge Impulse next to train a model on your own photos.
meta: Open Board. From $15.99. A few stores.
